reset_scope: entire inner cohort, source/destination requests are promoted

subcommands.0: CANCEL active job, mask0, full identity
subcommands.1: REQUEST_RESET mask1/2/3; idle identity fields zero
subcommands.3: RETRY_DRAIN after quarantine result consumed, bits143:8 zero

counter_contract: native response handshakes plus actual destination commits; ACK count includes negative abort acknowledgements; quarantined counters are timeout snapshots, not final side effects
epoch_contract: RELEASE epoch strictly above supervisor watermark after soft recovery; J1..255, no wrap
result_ownership: valid forwarded RESULT is immutable and suppresses duplicate terminal; unsuccessful RESULT probe does not suppress later fault terminal
memory_contract: no rollback; invalidate aborted outputs and rebuild required data after recovery
cdc_contract: single-clock synchronous host only; no multiclock CDC or physical RDC qualification
